International Police (as C)|gender = Male|aliases = C (codename)|height = 6'0" (182cm)|birthday = July 10|relatives = [[Rorim B]] (father)|affiliation = Pokemon Rangers International Police|currentLife = [[Kakori Village]]|hair = Green|eyes = Brown|age=19}} Crawli is the leader of [[Terajuma Island]]'s Pokémon Rangers, and the region's {{bp|Bug_(type)|Bug}} type gym leader. In addition to his work as a ranger, he is a member of the international police working under the code name "C". Legally blind because of a condition called [[Wikipedia:Retinitis pigmentosa|Retinitis pigmentosa]], his [[Galvantula]] aids him in navigating with his poor night vision.{{cite|Did you know? Crawli is legally blind! He has a condition called Retinitis pigmentosa. Or, RP for short! His Galvantula helps him scan the area using its compoundeyes. Though he usually only needs this at night.|A ranger|in [[Ranger HQ]]|V14}} __TOC__ __FORCETOC__ == Appearance == Crawli has short, green, and messy hair along with brown eyes. He wears white bracelets, and a black short sleeve shirt. He has black jeans with two pockets on both sides, maple-red shoes with darker red soles, and a maple-red collared vest. He also has a brown belt around his waist, secured by a silvery metallic clip. == Personality == == Biography == == Pokémon == |-|Story Mode= === Wispy Path === C is battled on a neutral field in a 3v3 Single Battle.
